adversarial_audit.objection: The second moment only lower-bounds lambda_max.
adversarial_audit.resolution: For PGM success it enters through a different Holder inequality that lower-bounds Tr sqrt(B), not upper-bounds the operator norm.

adversarial_audit.objection: The theorem silently assumes pure coset states.
adversarial_audit.resolution: It is derived directly for normalized equal-rank projector states and the canonical mixed-state PGM.

adversarial_audit.objection: Constant PGM success is an efficient quantum algorithm.
adversarial_audit.resolution: No. Dense inverse square root is information-theoretic; no polynomial implementation or structured preconditioner is supplied.

adversarial_audit.objection: Conditional source branches all inherit the same bound.
adversarial_audit.resolution: Only their natural weighted average is controlled. Individual Fourier-label branches can have much lower success.

claim_gate.reason: The PGM has constant all-n information-theoretic success with O(log n!) samples. Its coherent multiplicity whitening remains unimplemented and generically has factorial spectral resolution.

falsifiers_triggered: The multiregister PGM success probability is no longer an open information-theoretic obligation for the hidden bridge ensemble.
A second frame moment can certify PGM success through Tr sqrt(B), even though it cannot upper-bound the frame operator norm.
Constant information-theoretic success does not remove the factorial coherent frame-whitening implementation barrier.

proof_obligations.resolution: Every nonidentity right-regular group element has zero trace; expanding the two involution projectors gives overlap 1/2 per copy.
Cauchy--Schwarz on P_s B^-1/2 P_s and Holder on the eigenvalues of B give the stated lower bound.
The canonical seed still requires B^-1/2, equivalently coherent multiplicity tight-frame whitening, at factorial spectral scale.

summary: Converted the exact projector-frame second moment into an all-n PGM success lower bound above one half at the information threshold.

theorem_contract.projector_overlap: Tr(P_s P_t)/r=1 for s=t and 2^-k for s!=t.
theorem_contract.source_label_decomposition: The regular-representation Fourier source labels commute with the projector ensemble and its PGM, so the theorem is the natural-source average of conditional carrier PGMs.
